boundary.evidence: self-contained CLI gate in compliance-data-lifecycle/scripts; wired into SKILL Step 1 + table

ownership.evidence: CLASSES + PII_INDICATORS single source; data map is the classification owner

dependency.evidence: grep-battery clean — only node:fs/node:path, no web/transport

error-handling.evidence: fail-closed exit 2 on missing/bad map, invalid class (both forms), zero-scan, unreadable; violations exit 1
asserts exit codes incl fail-closed paths

findings.title: ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS <pii> silently passed (column never detected)
findings.question: error-handling
findings.whatBreaks: the canonical idempotent-migration idiom defeated the gate — unclassified PII shipped GREEN
findings.evidence: reviewer: `ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS email text;` → exit 0, 0 PII columns
findings.resolution: addRe consumes optional `if not exists`; test added (#1)

findings.title: a bare not-personal key blanket-exempted the column name across all tables
findings.question: ownership
findings.whatBreaks: `{email: not-personal}` exempts users.email (real PII) too — the escape hatch became a silent blanket suppression
findings.resolution: declare() rejects a bare not-personal key (must be table-qualified); test added (#2)

findings.title: username/nickname/display_name/fullname missed by the name heuristic
findings.question: ownership
findings.whatBreaks: direct identifiers ship unclassified; 'errs toward flagging' was false for these
findings.resolution: added /user ?name|nickname|display name|handle/ + fullname; kept bare `name` excluded by design (documented); test added (#3)

findings.title: multi-ADD-COLUMN ALTER scanned only the first column
findings.question: error-handling
findings.whatBreaks: `ADD COLUMN email, ADD COLUMN ssn` missed ssn
findings.resolution: iterate all ADD matches on the line (global regex) + keyword filter; test added (#4)

findings.title: unbalanced paren in a string literal ended the CREATE block early
findings.question: error-handling
findings.whatBreaks: a `DEFAULT ')'` nulls the block and skips every later column incl PII
findings.evidence: reviewer: `flag boolean DEFAULT (true)), email text` → email missed
findings.resolution: parenDelta neutralizes string literals before counting; test added (#5)

findings.title: ALTER TABLE ONLY misattributed the table as 'ONLY'
findings.question: boundary
findings.whatBreaks: table-qualified map key won't match; error names wrong table
findings.resolution: allow optional `only` after ALTER TABLE; test added (#6)

findings.title: single-line multi-column CREATE misses all columns
findings.question: error-handling
findings.whatBreaks: `CREATE TABLE t (email text, ssn text);` → both missed
findings.resolution: accepted as documented v1 limitation (header + ADR disclose it); also fixed a latent bleed where a single-line CREATE left the block open for the next line

verdict: 7 findings (1 high, 4 med, 2 low); 6 fixed with tests, 1 (single-line CREATE) accepted as documented
